officialHost.finalPackage: The final TGZ is installed again in the same synthetic profile. Exact file hashes and final-package strict restore are recorded in the delivery validation/installed-files.json and host-stage-6.json; no claim of user-profile installation.

failureCorrections: Official rc.1 tools use ToolBatchInput and a native executor; the adapter now validates the unique returned call ID rather than using the removed single-call contract.

Retained asynchronous projection definitions now await initialization/readiness; model selection uses Agent.model.select and flush, while released children receive only the official durable model/selection event.
The presentation-only rc.1 prompt waterfall no longer reads removed assembly.tools; official tool schema ownership and context isolation remain intact.
The first full suite had 20 migration/metadata failures. Central fixes restored exact ThoughtDAG/Codinput anchors, SDK lifecycle fixtures and upstream composition.

The next full suite had 14 failures: 13 installer fixtures still targeted rc.5 and one required a retired Nexus usage client. Fixtures now target rc.1, retain all fail-closed signature/version cases and explicitly verify retirement; two additional valid old-host upgrade cases were added.

Independent official Host first rejected subagent contexts lacking finite order and a Git Bash preset lacking sampleOverCapGlobResults. The implementation now uses the official subagent context order, distinct per-tool IDs and the official required preset default. Original preset admission assertions were retained.

Forge first expected the old 31-tool official baseline. The reviewed rc.1 baseline is 34; tests now require preserving those tools plus all five Forge additions, actual file I/O, persistent PowerShell and uninstall restoration.

The first Cognition run failed its newly selected UTF-8 guard because the npm subset omits Hive MCP source. Three public Git-blob-verified fixtures from commit 2f89485b394669ad70e7617f4e12de008e1291e6 are copied only into the isolated test tree; no Hive runtime/daemon is added. zstandard 0.25.0 was installed in a disposable validation environment.

The new standalone delayed fixture first omitted the normal request ID/permission/authority evidence. Corrected fixture calls use the same formal capability boundary; production authorization was not relaxed.

Final archive audit caught stale Turn Rewind/Codinput identity assertions, an unrebased Turn Rewind compatibility range and one public Cognition tilde-path example. Exact pinned identities and rc.1 compatibility were corrected; a path-and-complete-line-only documented exception has positive, mutated-line and other-file negative tests. Four targeted artifact-audit tests passed; all other scan rules remain active.
